Product: real-time 2D pixel-art multi-agent visualizer; React/Vite/Three.js/TypeScript frontend, Python FastAPI/LangGraph backend; optional Tauri wrapper. Use OpenAI GPT-4o-mini (switchable to local). Project: `<REDACTED_USERPATH>/agent-marketplace-demo/`; frontend `src/`, backend `agent-backend/` (agents, models, sprites).

Prefix sessions with a Council role: Architect (architecture/risks), Analyst (requirements/planning), Implementer (code), Reviewer (quality). Roles coordinate only; all agents are fungible generalists.

ALWAYS use `bd` from the project directory. Always read AGENTS.md and README.md; register with Agent Mail, introduce yourself, check inbox, and check Agent Mail between tasks. Work from the project directory. Use:
cd <REDACTED_USERPATH>/agent-marketplace-demo
bv --robot-triage
bv --robot-next
bv --robot-plan
bv --robot-insights | jq '.Cycles'
bv --robot-insights | jq '.bottlenecks'
**CRITICAL:** Never run bare `bv` — it launches interactive TUI that blocks.
Pick a useful bead; message Agent Mail with Subject `[bd-XXX] Starting task description`, Thread ID `bd-XXX`, and reserved files; mark `in_progress`.

Before editing, reserve files:
file_reservation_paths \
project_key="<REDACTED_USERPATH>/agent-marketplace-demo" \
agent_name="YourAgentName" \
paths=["src/components/AgentCanvas.tsx"] \
After work:
release_file_reservations \
project_key="<REDACTED_USERPATH>/agent-marketplace-demo" \
agent_name="YourAgentName"

Use strict TypeScript (no `any`), functional React/hooks, React Three Fiber, `useFrame`, `useThree`, shadcn/ui, `InstancedMesh` for 100+ identical sprites, sprite sheets, LOD, automatic frustum culling, and `renderer.setPixelRatio(1, 1)`. Backend: async FastAPI, Pydantic, LangGraph (`perceive`, `reason`, `act`), TypedDict state, LangChain OpenAI, batching, type hints everywhere, async I/O. No `console.log`; use proper logging. No hardcoded values; use constants/config. Handle errors; profile before optimizing; test critical paths.

After coding, carefully review all new code with fresh eyes, fix issues, repeat until none remain. Periodically deeply review other agents’ code; diagnose root causes and fix as needed. Mark bead `done`, release reservations, send `[bd-XXX] Completed`, respond to messages. Always communicate work, check mail, self-review, and never skip quality checks.

When a logical set is complete, commit changed files in logically connected groupings with detailed messages and push. Don't edit code at this point; don't commit ephemeral files.

Commit format: `[Component] Brief description` / `Related beads: bd-XXX, bd-YYY`.

If beads are missing, create: bd-001 initialize Tauri+React+TypeScript; bd-002 Three.js+R3F; bd-003 shadcn/ui; bd-004 FastAPI; bd-005 LangGraph; bd-006 pixel-art sprites; bd-007 render agent; bd-008 click detection; bd-009 detail panel; bd-010 frontend/backend connection.

When ending a session, work is NOT complete until `git push` succeeds:
1. File issues for remaining work.
2. Run tests, linters, builds if code changed.
3. Update issue statuses; close finished work.
4. PUSH TO REMOTE:
git pull --rebase
git status  # MUST show "up to date with origin"
5. Clear stashes, prune remote branches.
6. Verify all changes committed AND pushed.
7. Hand off context.

NEVER stop before pushing - that leaves work stranded locally.
NEVER say "ready to push when you are" - YOU must push.
If push fails, resolve and retry until it succeeds.
